class.name: DriverImplementation
class.description: What a driver makes of the orders it gets, and how it drives. A driver is always the same object of the system; what differs between the original's AI driver and any other is its implementation. Implement it in C++ by overriding the virtual methods, or in GDScript by overriding their script counterparts. Every callback carries the driver: a [Resource] is shared, so one implementation serves several drivers and keeps what it needs per driver RID. An implementation drives the vehicle only the way a player does, through the cab.

method.name: _control_taken
method.description: [param driver] drives its vehicle again - it sits at the controls ([VehicleServer]'s driver's role) after a player left them; the vehicle is as the player left it.

method.name: _driver_attached
method.description: [param driver] thinks with this implementation from now on.

method.name: _driver_detached
method.description: [param driver] no longer thinks with this implementation - it was given another, or the person was freed.

method.name: _get_seconds_until_departure
method.description: The seconds from [param hours] (the time of day) to the departure from the station the driver's train stands at or has just left, 0 where it only passes ([code]seconds_until_departure()[/code], [code]mtable.cpp:184-190[/code]); [code]NAN[/code] for a driver without a timetable ([method DriverServer.vehicle_get_seconds_until_departure]).

method.name: _get_state
method.description: What the driver keeps - its orders and what they asked for, in the implementation's own keys ([method DriverServer.driver_get_state]); empty for an implementation that shows nothing.

method.name: _get_timetable_state
method.description: The driver's timetable and how far it got through it: [code]timetable[/code] ([Timetable] or [code]null[/code]), [code]station_index[/code] (the entry it drives to next), [code]station_start[/code] (the entry shown as the station it stands at or has just left), [code]latency[/code] (minutes early on arriving at the last station, negative when late), [code]delay[/code] (minutes late at the station reached last, early when negative: its arrival as it arrives, its departure once the train has driven clear of it), [code]arrived[/code] (it has reached the next station and not gone on from it yet). Empty for an implementation that follows no timetable. An implementation reports a change with [method DriverServer.driver_report_timetable_changed].

method.name: _handle_command
method.description: An order for [param driver]: a scenario's [param command] with its two values, and the [param position] of what sent it.

method.name: _update
method.description: The time [param driver] asked for has come ([method DriverServer.driver_schedule_update]).
